name: Ekwo interface template

source.method: Rendered native DOM and stylesheet copied; project password login replaces Cloud code/OAuth; Cloud signup and legal footer removed; no Cloud runtime or backend configuration copied.

excluded: Cloud account, project and agent services
contract: Applications populate company-options, company-name, side-menu and account-name, bind company-toggle and sign-out, and provide page content. Native accounting links may open separately. No database or application identifiers are embedded.
